**What Reeks.** The owl on the campfire background has been sitting in that tree for months saying things like "RTFM" and "salt your hash." This time he noticed something. Every so often he leans off his branch and asks the whole forest **WHAT REEKS?!** Tap him while he's asking. Squachy will take it personally, and then he'll take the outfit.

<p align="center"><img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/skizzophrenic/SquachWatch-CYD/v1.29.0/docs/what-reeks.gif" width="480" alt="The owl on the campfire background asks WHAT REEKS?!, gets tapped, and Squachy answers that he showered last month. Then Squachy as the SHAMBLER: grey-green, a torn shirt over torn jeans, a bandage, one sneaker, a cracked lens and three flies, on the campfire and then in the aura. Then a visiting Legend walking in wrapped in his own aura, the SQUAD screen with its new SEND button, the main screen with its counters up and no NEARBY, and the aquarium."></p>

**The SHAMBLER.** The seventeenth outfit, picked from a lab of twelve zombies (a grave riser, a pirate, a frozen one, a punk, a miner with a canary who is somehow fine). Grey-green from his ears to his toes, a torn shirt over torn jeans, a stitched scar, a bandage coming loose, one tatty sneaker and one bare foot, a crack across his right lens, and three flies who will not leave him alone. One of them lands on his head for a rest now and then. He has made his peace with it. The owl asks about every minute and a half; on the campfire, Squachy's idle chatter starts hinting at the owl's nose until you get the idea. Once the outfit is yours the owl drops the question and goes back to his usual material.

**Legends visit in their aura.** Until now the aura only lit up your own screen, which is no way to flex. It travels with you now: a Legend with the aura on walks onto another board's screen wrapped in it, in a visit, in the crowd, on the SQUAD screen and on the desk's message card. Nobody borrows yours, either. A board on an older release just sees a plain visitor.

**SQUAD got a SEND button.** Bottom right, across from BACK. Writing to your squad from that screen used to mean tapping a message in the inbox and replying to it, which is hard to do with an empty inbox. Now you just press SEND.

**NEARBY stops shouting about your own things.** If you've ignored or snoozed a device (your own AirTag, your own doorbell) it no longer brings up the NEARBY headline. The counters underneath still count it, so you can see it's there; it just isn't news.

**The C5 draws faster.** The RockBase NM-CYD-C5 now sends each picture to the screen in the background while it draws the next one. The aquarium went from about 15 frames a second to 20, night city from 20 to 25. It's still on the flasher as a BETA; tell us how it does.

### The actually-useful part

**Added**
- SHAMBLER, a new outfit: tap the owl on the FIRE background while he asks WHAT REEKS?!. Hints on FIRE while it's locked; the master unlock includes it.
- A SEND button on the SQUAD screen's in-range page, which opens the message screen.

**Changed**
- A Legend's aura now shows on other boards when they visit, using a spare bit in the squad advert. Older boards show them without it.
- The squad radio carries eighteen outfit slots. Older boards show a visiting SHAMBLER as plain Squachy.
- The NEARBY headline needs a live device that is neither ignored nor snoozed; the counters are unchanged.
- NM-CYD-C5: the frame goes to the panel by DMA from its own task while the next one is drawn, into a second frame buffer.
- The outfit gallery in the README shows all seventeen costumes.
